description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for GstCapabilities and its factory, which are responsible for querying and managing GStreamer capabilities such as supported MIME types and caps. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to GStreamer capabilities handling within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class that creates instances of GstCapabilities, providing a singleton-like access point.

classes.name: GstCapabilities
classes.description: Implements the IGstCapabilities interface, providing methods to query supported MIME types and caps from GStreamer.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IGstCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported by GStreamer for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported by GStreamer.
